content: This paper presents a new method for jointly selecting important longitudinal functional features and classifying categorical outcomes, using a logistic-loss optimization framework tailored to high-dimensional healthcare data. It solves the problem efficiently with functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm, and shows strong performance in simulations and a real study of chronic diseases and health/socio-demographic factors.
